work_block: Day2 (milestone label; actual execution date in UTC receipts)
scope: exploratory 48h feasibility scout; no confirmation and no publication efficacy claim
development_selection_rule: smallest8 IDs in previously frozen development role, independent of Day2 outputs
prior_exposure: dev2 Day1 smoke outcomes already seen; all8 remain development; human prior Lee history unresolved

preprocessing.filter_scope: each isolated four-second trial; no learned statistics

training_arm: practical: all18 source people session1 + only current target session1 history
n0_reuse: one1800-source fit per model predicts all8 dev people; no refit per target

probability_schema.tie_rule: first class on exact probability tie

inference_unit: 8 development subjects; fixed source and one draw, exploratory only

bootstrap.method: paired subject percentile; same resampled person indices across2models and2doses
bootstrap.multiplicity: no confirmatory inference; CIs descriptive, no hypothesis promotion

null_control.scope: permute evaluation labels within each subject, shared permutation across model/dose; no refits

scout_decision.selection_boundary: sign(mean(BA_CSP0-BA_TS0)) and sign(mean(BA_CSP15-BA_TS15)) differ strictly; abs tie tolerance1e-12
scout_decision.GO_TO_DEVELOP: required outputs and controls valid; representative resource forecast within proposed pilot cap; no verified fatal direct-overlap finding in executed review; abs(D)>=0.02 or strict mean winner change
scout_decision.KILL: verified direct duplication of the scoped proposed claim, or required study cannot fit200coreh/80GB without changing required comparisons
scout_decision.INCONCLUSIVE: engineering valid but no prespecified signal; or resources/literature readiness genuinely cannot be assessed; no claim of zero effect
scout_decision.ERROR: missing/invalid required input/run, label/identity/scorer/null-control defect unresolved
scout_decision.limitations: GO means bounded development investigation only; S1 novelty, full pilot, confirmation and publication gates remain separate

timing_only_probes.predict_batch: first100 source training epochs; timing only, no accuracy reported
